{{Quote|The Empire's attacking Moraine Territory. That's where the resistance started; mostly villages and factories. Moraine Territory's also where we hid our families. But now the Imps have found them. Hundreds&hellip; hundreds are already dead.|Gave Dovaro|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Moraine Territory''' was the name given to the western end of the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Mostly villages and factories, it was the starting place of the [[Balmorran resistance]], and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded the area during their retreat from Balmorra.
